title: Drone Synth
tagline: Dual-oscillator drone with generative plasma visuals
description: Knob sets base pitch, slider detunes the second oscillator. Buttons cycle 4 unified audio/visual modes; hold a button for the visual shift layer.

title: Peepsy Acid
tagline: TB-303 style acid bassline & drum sequencer
description: 303 resonant filter basslines with kick & hi-hats. Left pot controls filter cutoff resonance, right pot selects patterns (Classic Acid, Arpeggio, G-Minor Groove, Octave Jumps). Press button to play/stop.

title: Flappy Slider
tagline: Interactive obstacle game with chiptune sound effects
description: Play Flappy Bird using the slider pot to control elevation and the left pot for speed! Features dynamic chiptune fanfare, pass sounds, collision sfx, and gap difficulty modes.

title: Bass Patterns
tagline: Punchy 808 sub-bass, kicks, snares & rhythm generator
description: Algorithmic kick/sub-bass drum machine with snare noise. Left pot morphs between deep 808 sub-bass and laser zaps. Right button cycles 6 rhythm presets, left button generates random patterns.

title: Minimal Techno
tagline: Hypnotic rolling basslines & tight minimal groove
description: Rolling sub-bass sequencer with 4 patterns (Deep Minimal, Rolling Bass, Sparse Sub, Driving Techno). Left pot controls filter cutoff, right pot selects patterns (or adjust tempo in shift mode).

title: Deep Minimal
description: Plucky off-beat sub basslines and syncopated percussion for deep late-night techno. Macro knob controls cutoff & decay, right pot sets pattern or BPM in shift mode.

title: Quantum DJ
tagline: Granular 1-bit quantum noise with chaotic NeoPixel sparks
description: Bytebeat granular streamer that turns internal ADC noise and sine modulation into alien chiptune rhythms. Slider controls slowdown, pot selects glitch modes. Buttons cycle 5 color palettes.

title: Ave Maria (Siberia)
tagline: Haunting liturgical Ave Maria with deep bass drone & Soviet star
description: Russian Orthodox liturgical interpretation of Schubert's Ave Maria. Deep D2 bass pedal drone, sacred choral arpeggios, and soaring melody. Left pot adjusts tempo & tone, right pot controls sub drone profundis. Buttons toggle Soviet Red Star, Kremlin Spire, and Siberian Blizzard visuals.

title: Lambada
tagline: Kaoma's tropical summer anthem with accordion & Carimbó groove
description: Full 16-bar arrangement of Lambada ('Chorando se foi') in D minor. Left pot sets tempo (70-160 BPM), right pot controls bass punch & lead brilliance. Left button cycles 4 voices (Accordion, Marimba, 8-Bit, Saw), right button cycles 4 visualizers, hold both for Turbo Stutter Roll!

title: Axel Foley
tagline: Harold Faltermeyer's 1984 synth classic, Moog bass & LinnDrum
description: Full arrangement of Beverly Hills Cop theme 'Axel F' in F minor. Left pot adjusts tempo (90-150 BPM), right pot controls 80s filter cutoff & Moog punch. Left button cycles 4 voices (Jupiter-8 Brass, DX7 Bell, C64 SID, Moog Saw), right button cycles retro visualizers (Police Siren, Outrun Grid, Boombox EQ, Neon Chase), hold both for machine-gun stutter roll!

title: Auf der Heide
tagline: Vintage German brass march, Oom-Pah tuba & the 3 stomps
description: Traditional arrangement of 'Auf der Heide blüht ein kleines Blümelein' ('Erika') in G major. Features brass horns, alternating oom-pah tuba bass, and the 3 heavy stomps ('BUM! BUM! BUM!'). Left pot controls marsch-tempo (75-140 BPM), right pot sets tuba depth. Left button cycles 4 voices (Brass, Accordion, Chiptune, Glockenspiel), right button cycles visualizers, hold both for snare roll!

title: Legend of Zelda
tagline: 3-voice SID sound engine with dynamic PWM, fast arps & march
description: Full-scale arrangement of Koji Kondo's 1986 Zelda Overworld Theme in Bb major powered by an authentic Commodore 64 SID chiptune engine. Features dynamic pulse-width modulation (PWM LFO), 50Hz tracker-style fast arpeggiator chords, hardware-style ADSR envelopes, and military march snare. Left pot controls quest tempo, right pot sweeps resonant SID filter & PWM depth.
